title: Quote with fuel surcharge
body:
Sales wants quotes that already include the fuel surcharge.

Add `quote_with_surcharge(weight_kg, zone)` to `parcelo/rates.py`. It returns the normal quote for that weight and zone plus the fuel surcharge for the zone. The surcharge percentages are the same ones `fuel_surcharge` in `parcelo/legacy/billing.py` already uses.

An unknown zone must fail, and so must a weight that is zero or negative.
